create_subsample_dataset: create a SubsampleDataset to randomly subsample a dataset by a specified size ratio
build_subsample_with_shuffle: build a SubsampleDataset with shuffle enabled to randomize batch ordering during training
test_ordered_indices: test the ordered_indices method to verify batch construction order with or without shuffling
review_subsample_getitem: review the SubsampleDataset __getitem__ method to understand how it maps indices to the wrapped dataset
refactor_prefetch_indices: refactor the prefetch method to translate subsampled indices back to the original dataset indices
